name: Sakuranomiya Arisa
source:
Nanagane Gakuen class 2-4 student, member of the "Go Home Club".

Arisa is a bright airhead who is popular as the school's idol. She is Otoha's best friend. Her hobby is cosplay.

[Translated from [url=http://www.lunasys.info/cate_archive/c_character/page/3]official website[/url].]
